title: Article: A Mysterious Lok: Kalyan Lok

segments.text: Any person could remove negativity which is below his or her dimension, here comes the dimension concept, in short dimension is the level where a person lies in the astral world, for example if a person has x dimension then that person or the energy behind that person could access energies which energy are equivalent or below that particular dimension. So, if the dimension of the negativity is higher than that person’s dimension or higher than the dimension of the energy behind that person then that negativity would not be visible to that person or to the energy behind that person because of which that negativity can’t be removed that’s why Parikshit Bhaiya himself checks aura of ashaeiynn aspirants on monthly basis. Since our gurudev “Shri Hanumanji Maharaj” is the energy who is standing behind him & with the help of our gurudev the things that gets told to that aspirant are always correct because our gurudev is also upgrading his dimension continuously & therefore all the negativities gets removed.
NOTE : If a person has very strong aura then that person would be affected by higher dimension negativities only, negativities at lower dimension would not affect that person.
Relation Of Mantra Jaap With Dimension

Mantra Jaap helps a person to reach at higher dimension, so if the person chants mantra regularly he or she continuously upgrading their dimension, whenever a person starts mantra jaap then the mantra shakti of that person creates a path upwards & that same mantra shakti takes the kundalini shakti upwards through that path.

One thing which exeryone should know here that, when a person chants mantra regularly he or she is upgrading his or her dimension continuously as told earlier, then that time at that particular dimension where he or she is would be attacked by the energies which are already at that dimension, this could be sometimes called as higher dimensional energies are taking test or attack from those energies & this is inevitable everyone has to go through this.

A person who has power to remove negativities & doesn’t have drishti, chaos happens at the house of that person, since all the negativities removed by that person stays always with that person & affects his or her family & relations.

So, here comes the concept of kalyan lok, to solve this problem our gurudev “Shri Hanumanji Maharaj” has assigned a lok to ashaeiynn people which is known as “ Kalyan lok “, in ashaeiynn all the negativities are send to Kalyan lok.

A lok with the help of our gurudev “Shri Hanumanji Maharaj” & with the blessings of eleven deities is assigned to send all the negativities which is known as “Kalyan lok” in ashaeyein. It is connected to “Pretraj Sarkar” which is also as “Mehendipur Balaji.

Kalyan lok works as a bridge between ashaeiynn & Mehendipur Balaji. It has different 16 subsections based on the category of the negativity & pitra, they are send to their respective subsections, whether it is negativity as pitra they gets beaten there to get purified by removing their malinta, once they get purified that negativity have to promise to surrender themselves to our gurudev, do bhakti or become spiritual after this, they are send to ‘Mehendipur- Balaji where they chant mantra till their yoni gets changed.

NOTE : Kalyan lok gets energy from eleven deities who gave the permission for Kalyan lok, which is handled by our gurudev “Shri Hanumanji Maharaj” himself. For the continuous working of kalyan lok is dependent upon the continuous energy which is given by our gurudev eventually with the help of ashaeiynn where people always chant mantra, sadhna & generating energy continuously.
How to send negativity or pitra to kalyan lok :

An ashaeiynn aspirant who chants “Jai Siya Ram” regularly more than 2 hours daily is able to send the negativity or pitra to kalyan lok using negativity or pitra prayer given by ashaeiynn & hence therefore people here are themselves able to remove their negativities.
